owner_request: 2026-10-14: Notion task 建立一周区间交易系统 (indicator 周一高低点区间 v1.8) - 「详细分析我这个任务 有什么建议？」. The task lists 「做一些手动回测 todo」; this is the mechanical first pass of the rules as written.
question: Does the owner's weekly Monday-range rule set as written (Tuesday-Friday break of the Monday low/high, 5m close back inside, stop at the deviation extreme, 80% at the far 0.618 and 20% at the opposite 1.13 extension) earn positive net R after 0.2% round-trip cost and beat matched random entries in the same week with the same stop and target distances, in both periods?
prior_evidence: None in this repo for Monday ranges. The same week profile idea (ICT weekly profile, RektProof range deviation) is described in owner-provided material but untested.

rule.monday_range: high H and low L of the complete 5m bars dated Monday NY; at least 276 of 288 bars present; R = H - L > 0
rule.window: Tuesday 00:00 to Saturday 00:00 NY; positions still open are closed at the close of the last Friday 1m bar
rule.long: arm on the first window 5m bar whose low < L; signal on the first 5m close > L at or after the arming bar; entry at the next 5m open; stop = lowest low from arming through the signal bar; TP1 = L + 0.618 R for 80%, TP2 = H + 0.13 R for 20%
rule.short: mirror: arm on high > H, signal on close < H, stop = highest high since arming, TP1 = H - 0.618 R (80%), TP2 = L - 0.13 R (20%)
rule.per_week: first signal per side per week only; skipped when the entry is not between stop and TP1
rule.fills: 1m path from the entry minute: stop first when stop and target print in the same minute; an open beyond the stop fills at the open; targets fill at the target price
rule.threshold_source: owner Notion text and indicator v1.8 levels; nothing tuned

variants.primary: rules as above, the remaining 20% keeps the original stop after TP1
variants.fib_113: the deviation must reach the 1.13 extension (low <= L - 0.13 R, high >= H + 0.13 R) before a close back inside counts (只在关键斐波那契点位开仓)
variants.be_after_tp1: after TP1 the remaining 20% stop moves to the entry price
variants.tp1_near: TP1 at the near 0.618 drawn from the other end (H - 0.618 R = L + 0.382 R for a long; L + 0.618 R for a short) - the task text 止盈在0.618 can mean either line. Added 2026-10-14 after the first results (post-hoc, ambiguity found while writing the read-out)
variants.fib_113_tp1_near: fib_113 plus tp1_near; read against fib_113 (one change)

controls.pool: same symbol, same week, same side, entry at a random window 5m open from Tuesday 00:00 NY to Friday 20:00 NY
controls.levels: stop, TP1 and TP2 at the event's distances in percent of entry

data: Binance USD-M monthly 1m archives for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE/BNB USDT at data/research/ma6_knot_1m_20261011 (exp-ma6-knot-breakout-20261011-v1), complete-bucket 5m
primary: per side, variant primary: mean net R, win rate, mean excess over matched controls and month-block sign-flip p, in 2023-2024 and 2025-2026. Pass = net mean > 0 in both periods and excess > 0 with p < 0.05 in at least one. Variants are single changes read against primary.
